entries.text: AI agents crossed from demo to deployment this year.
Seventy three percent of teams now ship agent features to production, up from almost nothing twelve months ago.
The cost to run a single agent task fell from dollars to cents.
And the tooling finally caught up. Frameworks for building agents multiplied ten times over.
Beautiful visuals from JSON are no longer a hack. They are a pipeline.
